title: Remove Recursive run_id Scanning From Audit Package Validator

context.remaining_blocker: PR #2 now uses structured text reading for summary.md, but run_id consistency still recursively scans arbitrary nested dict/list values using _find_run_ids. This violates the required canonical run_id scope and can falsely fail valid packages containing metadata/reference/baseline run IDs.
already_ok: invalid UTF-8 in JSON file has structured test coverage
principles: Do not touch unrelated exporter formatting or CLI behavior

task.summary: Replace recursive run_id collection with canonical package-field collection and add regression tests proving nested non-canonical run IDs are ignored.
task.user_story: As an Ailuros maintainer, I want run_id consistency validation to check only canonical package locations so referenced or baseline run IDs inside metadata do not cause false validation failures.
non_goals: Do not change summary.md error handling that is already fixed on the PR branch.
Do not change CLI JSON output shape.
Do not change decision values PASS, REVIEW_REQUIRED, FAIL.
Do not add HTTP API, dashboard, runtime ingestion, runtime blocking, auth, sessions, or policy DSL.
Do not introduce Clarify/EverRun/radarCreation/browser/UI/domain-specific concepts into src/ailuros.

required_changes: Delete _find_run_ids if no longer used, or leave it unused only if removal causes unnecessary churn; judge should prefer deletion.
Implement canonical run_id collection only from manifest.run_id and run.run_id plus direct run_id fields on top-level records in timeline, decisions, evaluations, and regressions lists.
Do not inspect nested metadata.run_id, payload.run_id, baseline.run_id, previous.run_id, evidence.run_id, baseline_run_id, compared_run_id, referenced_run_id, or similar non-canonical fields.
Keep missing run_id errors for manifest.json and run.json.
Keep direct canonical mismatch failures for manifest/run/timeline/decisions/evaluations/regressions direct run_id fields.
Preserve existing summary.md structured read behavior and parse aggregation behavior.
required_tests: A package with decisions[0].metadata.run_id = 'other-run' and direct canonical run_id = 'run-001' still returns PASS.
A package with evaluations[0].baseline.run_id or referenced_run_id = 'baseline-run' and direct canonical run_id = 'run-001' still returns PASS.
A package with regressions[0].baseline_run_id or compared_run_id = 'baseline-run' and direct canonical run_id = 'run-001' still returns PASS.
A package with timeline[0].run_id = 'other-run' still returns FAIL for mismatched run_id values.
A package with decisions[0].run_id = 'other-run' still returns FAIL for mismatched run_id values.

acceptance_criteria: _collect_run_ids no longer calls a recursive helper over arbitrary nested values.
No recursive helper scans every nested dict/list for keys named run_id as part of validation.
Nested metadata/reference/baseline run IDs no longer cause validation failure when canonical fields are consistent.
Direct canonical run_id mismatches still fail deterministically.
Existing tests for valid, missing file, malformed JSON/JSONL, missing required run_id, invalid root types, block/review decisions, and CLI behavior continue to pass.

notes: Full pytest may still fail due to known unrelated Clarify/release smoke baseline issues. Report exact failures if so.

must_check: _collect_run_ids uses only manifest.run_id, run.run_id, and direct run_id fields on timeline/decisions/evaluations/regressions list records.
_collect_run_ids does not recursively traverse arbitrary nested dict/list values.
Tests prove nested non-canonical metadata/reference/baseline run IDs do not fail validation.
Tests prove direct canonical timeline and decisions run_id mismatches still fail.
summary.md structured read behavior remains intact.
CLI JSON output behavior remains intact.
No forbidden paths or reference-app concepts are introduced.
All validation commands are run and reported honestly.
reject_if: _collect_run_ids still calls _find_run_ids or any recursive arbitrary run_id scanner.
Nested metadata.run_id, payload.run_id, baseline.run_id, referenced_run_id, baseline_run_id, or compared_run_id still causes mismatched run_id failure.
Direct canonical run_id mismatch checks are weakened or removed.
Tests are loosened, removed, or avoid the nested non-canonical run_id cases.
The change expands scope into unrelated CLI/export/docs/API/dashboard/runtime/auth/policy work.
Validation failures are hidden or claimed as green without evidence.
